card.name: Inside eponymous syndrome names
card.fires_on: The middle of hyphenated eponym syndrome names, mainly Lesch-Nyhan and Ehlers-Danlos, just before the hyphen. It also fires on 'flu' in 'flu-like'.

modes.label: Lesch-Nyhan
modes.description: Fires on 'Les' or 'ch' inside Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, usually in lists of genetic disorders.

modes.label: Ehlers-Danlos
modes.description: Fires on 'ERS' or 'lers' inside Ehlers-Danlos before the hyphen.

modes.label: Flu-like
modes.description: Fires on 'flu' before a hyphen in 'flu-like' symptoms.

card.writes: Little clear meaning; it seems to help predict a hyphen and the rest of a name, and discourages words like progressive or gradual.
card.plain: It fires partway through the names of hyphenated syndromes like Lesch-Nyhan and Ehlers-Danlos.
